title: Restricted-weight bias parameters
statement: Given a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input with small-bias parameters $(n,a,b)$ and family-size bound $M$, the restricted-weight bias parameters have dimension $n$, numerator $a^2$, and denominator $8(4Mb)^2$. Thus the dimension and numerator are positive and twice the numerator is at most the denominator.
hypotheses_covered: The Fourier $1$-norm bound is at least one
